subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The advocate who **__appeared to the accused__** was least hopeful of the case.
solution:
The correct answer is **"appeared for the accused."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Appear for'** is the correct phrasal verb to use when someone is representing or defending someone else in a legal case. (जब कोई कानूनी मामले में किसी अन्य का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रहा हो या उसका बचाव कर रहा हो तो **'Appear for'** सही वाक्यांश क्रिया है)
 
• The preposition **'to'** is incorrect in this context.
 
 
• **Example**: *Karan was **appearing for**__ the defence.*
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that the advocate was not optimistic about the outcome of the case.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The advocate who __**appeared for the accused**__ was least hopeful of the case.*
